keyVerseDR: "He that hath two coats, let him give to him that hath none..." (Lk 3:11)

level1.title: What Should We Do?
level1.story: People asked John, "What should we do?" John said, "Share your coat and your food!" He said Jesus is coming soon, and the people were full of joy.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did John say to share?
actions: Give away a coat or toy
level1.prayer: Jesus, fill me with joy. Amen.

activity.title: Share like John said
activity.intro: Write 3 ways to share your coat, food, or time.
activity.label: Ways I can share with joy

level2.title: Rejoice and Share
level2.story: The crowds asked John the Baptist, "What then shall we do?" He said, "He that hath two coats, let him give to him that hath none; and he that hath meat, let him do in like manner." He told tax collectors to be honest and soldiers to be fair and content with their pay. The people wondered if John was the Christ. John said, "One mightier than I shall come... He shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire."
level2.keyLine: He that hath two coats, let him give to him that hath none.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What would John tell kids to do?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me share Your joy. Amen.

activity.title: Share with joy
activity.intro: John said, "Share your coat and food." Plan what you will share.
